children: Quantum demonstrated detection of 19 amino acids in its Proteus development program and is deploying this capability into a developmental sequencing kit while aiming to detect all 20 amino acids by year-end 2026.
Announced detection of 19 amino acids in the Proteus development program—milestone for single-molecule protein sequencing.
Working to deploy 19-amino-acid detection into a developmental sequencing kit for routine use on integrated Proteus instruments.
Company expresses confidence in demonstrating detection of all 20 amino acids by year-end 2026.
Notes that 19-amino-acid capability is expected to further improve Proteus sequencing performance ahead of commercial launch in Q2 2027.
